method.label: mixed asymmetric-weighted Hermite bulk plus bounded Legendre residual

reference_paper.title: Mixed Hermite-Legendre spectral method for kinetic plasma simulations
reference_paper.publication_status: arXiv preprint; journal publication not asserted

method.bulk_representation: asymmetrically weighted Hermite basis on unbounded velocity coordinate
method.residual_representation: Legendre basis on finite velocity window [v_a, v_b]
method.coupling: highest Hermite coefficient feeds Legendre correction; both bases contribute to the self-consistent Poisson field
integrators: structured split with exact streaming and local Cayley force updates
IMEX with frozen-field backward-Euler Lorentz substep
structural_controls: optional low-mode moment correction for mass, momentum and energy
Legendre velocity-window penalty and boundary diagnostics
separate Hermite and Legendre artificial high-mode damping
optional BGK and Dougherty collision models
important_semantics: Hermite shift u and scale alpha are configuration parameters in the pinned implementation; no automatic time-varying frame update is claimed.
Legendre correction has finite velocity support and requires boundary adequacy checks.
The mixed basis is distinct from a single adaptive-Hermite basis and from the invariant-backbone plus compressed-residual hypothesis.
Backward-Euler IMEX stability must be evaluated alongside its numerical dissipation.

upstream_validation.interpretation: Upstream source's own mixed Hermite-Legendre test suite passed at this exact pinned commit. This is external baseline admission evidence, not an independent Symthaea reproduction.

characteristics.experiment_type: externally driven Maxwellian resonance followed by free ring-down

landau_driven_resonance.comparison_caveat: Not the same initial-value density-perturbed Landau case as Symthaea alpha=0.001/0.01; must remain a separate profile.

two_stream_imex.caveat: Upstream test documents Lawson non-finiteness at dt=0.01 and IMEX stability at dt=0.01; larger-step IMEX must be evaluated for dissipation and matched fidelity.

bump_on_tail.caveat: YAML comments additionally report a t=700 run and Nh/window behavior. Those are source comments, not the configured t=120 profile and not yet independently reproduced by Symthaea.

reproduction_requirements: Reproduce exact upstream test/configuration lanes before modifying the algorithm.
Keep driven Landau resonance separate from the initial-value Landau density perturbation experiment.
Run paired CPU comparisons first at identical precision and normalized physical initial conditions.
Separately report best documented CPU/GPU pathways; never conflate hardware advantage with algorithmic advantage.
Use a common diagnostic grid/quadrature and report both coefficients and reconstructed total distribution.
Count all basis transforms, closure coupling, Legendre projection, collision operators, moment correction, Poisson solve and I/O.
Measure Legendre boundary occupancy, Hermite and Legendre spectral tails, total f positivity/negative mass and all invariant drifts.
For IMEX, report phase error, damping/growth rate and energy dissipation beside stability and wall time.
Retain all failed, unqualified and resource-limited runs.
claim_ceiling: The pinned ADEPT implementation and its 31-test upstream CI result are admitted as an external comparator. No Symthaea reproduction, head-to-head result, speedup, stronger conservation, positivity guarantee, or production superiority is claimed.
